sector.quote: Founded in 2021 and headquartered in Melbourne, Australia, the Group provides public relations, digital marketing, content creation, marketing analytics and influencer management services to an international client base, with a primary focus on the real estate, hospitality, sports and retail sectors.

business_description.value: Voltage X is a creative and communications group providing public relations, digital marketing, content creation, marketing analytics and influencer management services to international clients. It uses AI-enabled platforms to support its services, mainly for clients in real estate, hospitality, sports and retail.
business_description.quote: Voltage X is an AI-native creative and communications group.
